title: Warbreaker
author: Brandon Sanderson
summary: Two sisters from a mountain kingdom find their lives pulled in different directions when one is sent to marry the god-king of a rival city. There, colour and breath are the basis of magic, and war is on the horizon.
readIf: you want a standalone fantasy with court intrigue, odd magic and a sarcastic cast.
skipIf: you want romance at the centre, or a very fast plot since the first half takes time to set the pieces.

pairings.reason: A single-volume fantasy of occupied kingdoms and political scheming, with more lyrical sorrow.
Same author, with a similar mix of unusual magic and heists, but a more propulsive tale of rebellion.
Another standalone with cleverly drawn women navigating courts and bargains, in a wintry fairy-tale style.
